profile.org_note: Family-owned LLC run by second-generation owners Lisa Ball and Mike Ball (co-CEOs per Builder; BBB calls Lisa Ball President), with co-founder Mira Ball as the third named Manager; President Ray Ball died in April 2023 and was not replaced by any announced hire. Three geographic divisions (Central Kentucky, Louisville, Knoxville) with no published division heads. No land or finance executive is published; land and entitlement decisions appear to sit with the owners and General Counsel Buddy Goodwin (outside zoning counsel used in Lexington).
profile.summary: Ball Homes is a 1959-founded, Ball-family-owned builder in Lexington, KY, ranked in the Builder 100 every year since 1999 (690 closings and $315M revenue in 2024 per Builder). It builds in Central Kentucky, Louisville and Knoxville, designs its own plans, develops many of its own subdivisions (e.g. Chilesburg in Lexington; 50- to 95-lot Knox County subdivisions entitled in 2025-2026) and has a captive lender (Walden Mortgage Group) and a rental-homes arm. A land-owning, self-developing family builder with no disclosed land-banking or outside capital partner.

BBB lists her as President; Builder's 2025 firm page lists the CEO as 'Lisa and Mike Ball'; she is one of three named Managers on the LLC's 2025 Kentucky annual report (gov record, Verified for the Manager role: https://web.sos.ky.gov/corpscans/63/0562663-06-99998-20250516-ARP-11865007-PU.pdf). A third-party data aggregator (elementix) instead calls her CEO. Phone is the company main office. Treat as the senior decision-maker together with Mike Ball. Title note: President per the BBB listing; co-CEO with Mike Ball per the Builder 100 firm profile.
